title: Currency transaction reporting
definition: The requirement to file a report on currency transactions exceeding the applicable threshold, in cash or in monetary instruments, conducted by one person in one business day. Transactions by a person are aggregated across branches, accounts and automated teller machines for the day, and a report covers the whole of the person's activity rather than each individual transaction. A set of exceptions exists for transactions between financial institutions, and for certain listed businesses. This record summarises the obligation.
evidence_to_cite: the filed report, its identifier and the period it covers
the aggregated transaction records for the person for the business day
the aggregation applied, and any exception relied on

sources.citation: Currency transaction reporting requirements and the aggregation rule (31 CFR 1010.311, 1010.313 and 1020.315), summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
